CheckTitle: Ensure AWS Security Hub is enabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that AWS Security Hub is enabled in every region.
Risk: Without Security Hub, findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie and Config are not aggregated or continuously checked against standards.

Recommendation.Text: Enable Security Hub in all regions with the CIS AWS Foundations and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices standards.
